model: MAPS / MAPS III / MAPS IV IQ Controller, Options D15 / D16 / D17 / D18 (BACnet point list)
applies_to: Reznor MAPS III units (from March 2010) and MAPS IV units with control option D15, D16, D17 or D18 and the IQ system controller (software 2.01), including the optional energy recovery module (ERM).
summary: MAPS III and MAPS IV units with control options D15-D18 use the Reznor IQ system controller, which speaks BACnet over MS/TP as standard (BACnet over ARCNET and LonWorks are options). The network point list has about 230 objects: occupancy and BAS on/off commands, space, neutral air and discharge air setpoints, fan, damper and economizer settings for each control option, heating, cooling and reheat settings, alarm flags, output status and the energy recovery module interface.
notes: Access comes from the Direction column: Input points are shown writable, Output points read-only. The guide has no explicit read/write column.
The object type is taken from the Object ID column. For AV 328 and BV 346-350 the Type column disagrees (BBV vs AV:328, BAV vs BV:346-350); the IDs are kept as printed.

AV 181 and AV 182 are listed twice (fan and damper sections) and kept once. AV 186-189 are reused: listed here with the four-speed supply fan names; in the GF four-position damper section the same IDs are four_pos_opn_min_1, four_spd_in1_pos_1, four_spd_in2_pos_1 and four_spd_cls_pos_1.
Most setpoints only apply to the fan (VFC), damper (GF), heating, cooling and reheat options ordered; ERM points need the energy recovery module.
Source: 9.6 BACnet Network Point List, guide pages 66-72 (form pages 65-71).

source.title: Control System Guide for Modular Air Processing System Units, Options D15, D16, D17, D18, D19 and D21 (MAPS III and MAPS IV)

integration.summary: Set the IQ controller's MS/TP baud and address on its DIP and rotary switches and the network number and device instance in the BACnet menu. If the schedule is configured for BAS control, command occupancy with BV 50 and on/off with BV 51, then write the occupied space setpoints or the neutral air setpoint. Monitor unit mode, occupancy status, the system shutdown flag and the alarm BVs.
integration.enable: BV 50 bas_occ_unocc_cmd_1 and BV 51 bas_on_off_cmd_1 control occupancy and on/off, but only when BAS control is selected in the schedule configuration. AV 52 lets a BACnet schedule pass minutes-until-occupied for optimum start. BV 178 resets a system shutdown.
setup: MS/TP is the standard protocol; default baud 9600 (19.2K, 38.4K and 76.8K selectable on DIP switches 1-2); protocol on switches 5-8.
Default network number 12345; device instance = 2400 + rotary address (default 02, so 2402).
The ERM controller has its own default device instance 2499.
Power must be cycled after changing DIP settings.
gotchas: Some objects' Type column contradicts the Object ID; verify AV 328 and BV 346-350 on the unit.
AV 186-189 change meaning with the fan or damper control option fitted.
